# Campaign Launch Brief: OmniTrack Pro Q2 Launch
OmniTrack Solutions - Enterprise Division

## Campaign Overview
- Objective: Drive qualified enterprise pipeline for OmniTrack Pro
- Flight Dates: 05/04/2026 to 06/30/2026
- Target Audience: Operations Directors and Fleet Managers in mid-market logistics
- Primary Goal: Generate 450 Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) at target CPA below $175

## Channel Allocations and Budget
| Channel | Allocated Budget | Primary Format | Projected Leads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Paid Search | $28,000 | High-intent non-brand keyword ads | 160 |
| Paid Social | $32,000 | Sponsored InMail and video demos | 190 |
| Industry Webinars | $15,000 | Co-hosted thought leadership panel | 100 |
| Total | $75,000 | Blended Mix | 450 |

## Action Plan and Deliverables
- Ad Creative Review: Advertising manager Derek Soto must deliver finalized creative assets for all channels.
- Landing Page QA: Creative ops will audit tracking pixels and ensure the primary landing page includes a prominent contact form, clear value proposition, and customer testimonials.
- Paid Search Setup: The paid media specialist will launch Google Ads campaigns using an allocated budget of $38,000 across targeted logistics keywords.
- Email Nurture Sequence: Deploy 4-part automated email series for webinar attendees triggered within 24 hours of live event completion.
- Weekly Reporting: Lead status updates and spend tracking distributed every Monday by 10:00 AM EDT to marketing leadership.
